messages:
Alex Chen: Quick question — SLO editor 'Compose' flow: when I swap routing policy from 'default' -> 'per-tenant', the UI doesn't show whether tenant overrides will be preserved on save. Is this expected?
Maria Gomez: Hmm, I saw that too. The preview only shows threshold deltas, not routing effects.
Devon Patel: That's intentional to keep preview latency low (we don't call routing-service in the live form). But that causes surprising saves.
Alex Chen: Could we show a lightweight 'effective routing' badge that says e.g. 'Routing: per-tenant (overrides present)' and an estimate of fanout?
Priya Singh: We can, but UI needs a stable telemetry contract: preview API must accept route_hint and return estimated_fanout + sample_rate. Example:
```http
POST /api/internal/slo/compose/preview
{
  \"threshold\": 0.985,
  \"route_hint\": \"tenant:acme-corp\",
  \"include_routing\": true
}
```
Devon Patel: If preview returns estimated_fanout we can show cost delta and a warning if it spikes >2x. :warning: 
Alex Chen: Nice. Also want the save flow to warn if switching routing will change notify targets (pager / slack) for any affected tenants.
Maria Gomez: Agreed. UX suggestion: show a small diff modal on save for routing/notify changes with accept/abort.
Priya Singh: Backend ops: routing-service already exposes /v1/routes/effective?tenant_id=... but it's a heavy call. We could cache recent results per-entity for Compose (TTL 30s).
Devon Patel: Caching sounds fine. We also need to extend telemetry schema: add `preview_source: 'compose_ui'` so we can filter sampling when computing estimates.
infra-bot: deploy slo-editor/compose-preview-caching -> staging succeeded (build 1.3.2)
Alex Chen: I'll open a GH issue with the API contract + UX mocks. Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1023 — please add API reviewers.
Maria Gomez: Adding @Priya for contract and @Devon for UI. I'll sketch the modal copy.
Devon Patel: I'll prototype the badge and the diff modal tomorrow, posting a screenshot in #design when ready. :eyes: 
Alex Chen: Thanks all — this should reduce surprise saves and alert noise.
